l.i: Fudirit, expreßis totidem facra pagina verbis
Non docet: at legimus non certo auctore relata,
Sancta tamen, quasi no fuderit ipse Manasses,
At Deus ipse illi poßit dicta ße videri.
Herconuper qua quum tibi texta, Paludi,
Carmine perlegerem, laudavi, & sic ego mecum
Ipse loquens, utinam Deus, inquam, Maxime,
Vel talis nostro nascatur in orbe Manasses,
Vel si natus erit, paucos aut regnet in annos,
Aut alter fiat, mutata mente, Manasses.

main_text.l: Is pueros, dixere, senes: oppono senectam
Bezæ ego Noftoreã: bis mihi Beza Vir est.
Is tibi Beza Vir est, Num quod bis Beza
maritus, Nulla probat proles quæ tamen esse Virum?
Qui tibi seruiuit tot, Chrifte, fideliter annos,
Ipse tua Bezam, quaso, tuere manu:

page.notes: Printed text is partly italic and partly roman; the last signature line "O 4" is the gathering mark. Some words in the first epigram and the second epigram are doubtful, e.g. "Noftoreã", "oppono", "Vir" and "Virum" (long s and u/v forms). Fragment at line-end "Fudirit" and "Hercon uper qua" kept as printed.
